deployments_detail.use: Carto — AI fragrance formulation tool (pre-screens thousands of formula variants, learns perfumer preferences; robotic device in Givaudan facilities)
Use of Datapeople's AI/NLP platform to analyze and improve job-ad language for inclusive, effective recruiting across Givaudan's talent-acquisition process. [Datapeople]

Carto, an AI-powered tool for perfumers that intelligently uses Givaudan's ingredient 'Odour Value Map' to suggest ingredient combinations and optimize fragrance formulations in real time; deployed across creation centres and the Digital Factory.

ATOM (Advanced Tools for Modelling), a proprietary AI system in Taste & Wellbeing that optimizes food and flavour formulation, identifies positive/negative flavour drivers, and facilitates co-creation with customers.
Vanilla AI, an AI-powered flavour-design tool that pinpoints optimal flavour combinations for consumer-preferred vanilla experiences faster than a traditional design-of-experiment approach.

Application of cheminformatics, machine learning and AI in R&D to develop novel aroma and taste molecules and build data-driven computational discovery pipelines (dedicated Cheminformatics Scientist roles and R&D program).

Myrissi, a patented AI technology (acquired 2021, launched as a service in 2023) that decodes fragrances into colour patterns and emotional resonance to guide branding and product development for customers. [Myrissi (Givaudan acquisition)]
Customer Foresight, a proprietary 'futurescaping' platform combining big data and AI with human futurescapers to identify early signals of future shifts in the food & beverage industry.

Creatogether, the fragrance industry's first AI-powered human-machine co-creation service, launched with Alibaba's Tmall Innovation Centre (TMIC) in China, enabling customers to co-create perfumes with AI-assisted creation and rapid sampling. [Tmall Innovation Centre (Alibaba)]
DigiPulse, a proprietary olfactive social-listening tool that uses AI to collect and decode consumers' spontaneous online comments about fine fragrances.
Aroma Kiosk / digital sensory insights tool that captures consumer data and personalized preferences in real time in dynamic environments (stores, malls) via an AI algorithm.

Givaudan Active Beauty partnered with Haut.AI to deploy AI skin analysis and SkinGPT generative simulation, unveiling a new active ingredient via personalized, photorealistic skin simulations at in-cosmetics Global 2026. [Haut.AI (SkinGPT)]
